name: Back In My Day
look: An elderly man in a black top hat, round wire-rimmed glasses, a gray scarf and a paisley cravat scowls and wags his index finger at the camera, as if scolding someone, against a plain beige wall.
use: A grumpy old-timer lectures about how things were harder or better in the past. The top caption starts 'Back in my day' and the bottom describes the exaggerated hardship or old-fashioned way of doing things.
slots: top caption: usually 'Back in my day'
bottom caption: how things used to be done
examples: we waited a whole week for the next episode
we memorized our friends' phone numbers
describe: angry old man in a top hat wagging his finger
grumpy grandpa with glasses scolding the camera
old guy in a scarf and top hat lecturing
elderly man pointing his finger telling kids how it used to be
cranky old timer in old fashioned clothes shaking his finger
